title: Fusion of nitro isomers of naphthoquinone enhances capacity and cyclability in Zn-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2207-2216
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01542H, Paper
Richa Gupta, Nikhil George Mohan, John Bell, Ashok Kumar Nanjundan, Kothandaraman Ramanujam
Introducing a nitro group reduces the solubility of quinone-based materials in aqueous Zn-ion battery electrolytes. A mixture of 5- and 6-nitro 2,3-dichloro 1,4-naphthoquinone enhances capacity and cyclability retaining capacity after 9600 cycles.
